title: A characterization of virtually free actions via arc spaces and its application to the lower semi-continuity conjecture
summary: In this paper, we study the precise inversion of adjunction (PIA) conjecture and the lower semi-continuity (LSC) conjecture for hyperquotient singularities. Previously known results for these conjectures in this setting required the singularity to be klt, and without this assumption, a counterexample to the PIA conjecture is known to exist. To resolve this obstacle, we introduce a localized notion of virtually free actions and characterize it via the arc spaces of quotient varieties.
